description.value: Parent-report Expression and Emotion Scale for Children used to assess emotion awareness and expression and to characterize emotion regulation and expression differences between groups. Subscales included positivity, emotional flatness, and emotional lability.

spans.text: The EESC is a reliable and consistent parent-report scale that assesses emotion awareness and expression in school-age children ( Perwien et al., 2008 ). Subscales include “positivity,” which assesses positive aspects of emotional expression, and two negative emotion subscales termed “emotional flatness” and “emotional lability.”

spans.text: The ERC is a parent-report instrument that assesses parents’ perceptions of their child’s emotional expression, empathy, and emotional self-awareness, where higher scores reflect more dysregulation. Subscales include “lability/negativity,” which assesses emotional lability and temper outbursts, and “emotion regulation.”
